_note: xAI's tokenizer, reachable over plain REST at /v1/tokenize-text. Their own SDK calls it over gRPC (xai_api.Tokenize/TokenizeText), which is a fact about that SDK and not about the API — the REST endpoint answers 200 with the same token list, so this needs no protobuf and no extra dependency. It tokenizes TEXT, not a chat request: the answer is exact for the string sent and excludes whatever framing the chat template adds around it.
